name: Saint Stephen
history: One of the seven deacons chosen by the apostles to serve the poor, Stephen was stoned to death in Jerusalem for his preaching, praying for his killers as he died. A young man named Saul held the cloaks of those who stoned him.
meditation: Lord, do not hold this sin against them. Forgive someone today.
prayer: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, to imitate what we celebrate, so that we may learn to love even our enemies; because we keep the anniversary of the invention of Him Who knew how to plead even for His persecutors with our Lord, Jesus Christ, Your Son. Who livest and reignest with God the Father…
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
